say:1:1230427001:1.text: I've been to a fair share of places with my comrades.
say:1:1230427001:1.source_cn: 我跟着兄弟闯荡过很多地方。
say:1:1230427001:1.male: I've been to a fair share of places with my comrades.
say:1:1230427001:1.female: I've been to a fair share of places with my comrades.

say:2:1230427002:1.text: But never have I ever run into anyone as unyielding as them.
say:2:1230427002:1.source_cn: 但像小水村女人那么厉害的，我还是第一次见到。
say:2:1230427002:1.male: But never have I ever run into anyone as unyielding as them.
say:2:1230427002:1.female: But never have I ever run into anyone as unyielding as them.

say:3:1230427003:1.text: While we've been here, what we stole from them can't even compare to the trouble they caused us.
say:3:1230427003:1.source_cn: 这段时间，我们并没有从她们手里讨到多少好处，反而吃了不...
say:3:1230427003:1.male: While we've been here, what we stole from them can't even compare to the trouble they caused us.
say:3:1230427003:1.female: While we've been here, what we stole from them can't even compare to the trouble they caused us.

say:4:1230427004:1.text: Finally, I can leave after promising the Carmine Whispers to abandon this stronghold.
say:4:1230427004:1.source_cn: 好在我们和血薇帮和解后，约定放弃这个据点。终于可以离开了。
say:4:1230427004:1.male: Finally, I can leave after promising the Carmine Whispers to abandon this stronghold.
say:4:1230427004:1.female: Finally, I can leave after promising the Carmine Whispers to abandon this stronghold.

say:5:1230427005:1.text: I don't have to be a thief anymore if I can make an honest living here in the future...
say:5:1230427005:1.source_cn: 以后要是能在锈锚港干点正经营生，就不用再靠抢别人过活了……
say:5:1230427005:1.male: I don't have to be a thief anymore if I can make an honest living here in the future...
say:5:1230427005:1.female: I don't have to be a thief anymore if I can make an honest living here in the future...
